name: Mystic Ticket
description: A ticket required to board the ship to Navel Rock.

gifts.note: Postgame, automatic. After you enter the Hall of Fame, your Dad is waiting when you come home. He gives you the Mystic Ticket and the Aurora Ticket from Mr. Briney, for the ferries at Slateport and Lilycove. A Nuzlocke challenge also ends at this moment. It can't be missed.
